decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The ground floor flat incorporating the basement, shall not be used any time other than for a single dwelling. The basement shall at no time be used or occupied separately from the ground floor flat (Flat 1, No. 41 Chiswick High Road, Chiswick W4 2LT).
Condition : 4 - The additional rooms to the basement hereby approved shall only be used for uses incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse and not used as main living rooms or bedrooms.
description: Enlargement of existing basement to provide study and gymnasium incorporating new light well to rear elevation of flat No. 1
